verdicts.message: AnalyzerSeverityNone: CA2007 — this rule is switched off for every file the section matches, in every project under this directory, and the only record that it was ever switched off is this line: nothing at the sites it would have reported says so, so a reader of that code has no reason to look here, and code added years from now inherits the decision silently. If the rule is genuinely unwanted here, say why — on this line after the entry, or in the comment run directly above it: a comment that only repeats the rule's own title is read as no explanation at all and leaves this row in place.

verdicts.message: The concept of the 'No Show' fee is named inconsistently. The policy class exposes a constant/string named `NoShow`, while the configuration options class exposes the same concept as `NoShowFee`. This creates ambiguity about whether `NoShow` is the fee amount, a reason code, or a flag, whereas `NoShowFee` is explicit.: Rename `CancellationPolicy.NoShow` to `NoShowFee` to align with `CancellationPolicyOptions.NoShowFee`, or rename `NoShowFee` to `NoShow` if the domain strictly uses 'NoShow' as the canonical term for the fee amount. (symbols: ClinicScheduling.Domain.Policies.CancellationPolicy.NoShow, ClinicScheduling.Domain.Policies.CancellationPolicyOptions.NoShowFee)
verdicts.reason: NoShow is a decision code (like LateCancellation), NoShowFee an amount: different concepts, consistently named.
